    AI Exam Paper Generator

    Our built-in AI tool lets teachers generate complete exam papers in seconds — from any typed text, PDF, or photo of a textbook. Save hours every week.

    📝

    Automatic Paper Generation

    Type a topic or paste text — the AI creates full exam papers with MCQs, short & long questions instantly.

    🖼️

    Generate from Images

    Photograph any textbook page or handwritten notes — the AI reads and creates exam questions from it.

    ⚡

    Multiple Question Types

    MCQs, fill-in-the-blanks, short questions, long answers — all generated and formatted automatically.

    📱

    Available on Teacher App

    Use AI paper generation directly from the mobile teacher app — no desktop needed.
